Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking this — I'm Aisha from Sapphire Holdings (AP lead). We're starting to set up a direct supplier relationship for managed cloud services and need a vendor master created in your system so POs and invoices route correctly. Below is the legal info we typically provide; attaching our company registration and W-9 now.

Legal name: Sapphire Holdings LLC
Doing business as (if any): Sapphire Cloud Services
EIN / Tax ID: 12-3456789
Legal address: 410 Harbor Way, Suite 200, San Mateo, CA 94401
Remit-to / banking contact: ap@sapphireholdings.com
Primary AP contact: Aisha Patel — aisha.patel@sapphireholdings.com — +1 (415) 555-0134
Invoice preference: PDF via email to ap@sapphireholdings.com; ACH payee on file
Is a PO required: yes — PO number must be on invoice for payment
Payment terms requested: Net 30

Attachments: Sapphire_Registration_2026.pdf, W9_Sapphire_2026.pdf

Can you confirm what additional fields you need (beneficial ownership, authorized signers, preferred PO contacts)? Also please let us know the vendor code once created so we can include it on our invoices.

Thanks — looking forward to moving our first PO through.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Accounts Payable | Sapphire Holdings

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: New vendor intake — Sapphire Holdings (legal entity)

Hi Aisha — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the registration + W-9. I can start the vendor master request now. A couple of asks so we capture everything on the first pass: 

- Beneficial owner / UBO confirmation: name(s) and percent ownership (required for our compliance team).
- Invoice remittance address (if different from legal address) and whether invoices should go to a shared mailbox or an AP contact.
- Bank instructions for ACH (you can send a redacted copy if you prefer) — required for us to set up electronic payments.
- Confirm the invoice contact and whether your invoices need a specific PO format (e.g., Redwood-PO-#### or our full PO number).

I'll start the intake now and attach to the vendor request. Looping in Jordan from AP (cc'd) to confirm PO handling and Marissa from vendor onboarding for any contract/notes capture.

Next steps from our side:
1) I submit vendor intake to Procurement — they validate legal docs and UBO.
2) AP (Jordan) configures PO routing and adds Sapphire to our payment queue.
3) We return a Vendor ID and confirm PO format + required fields.

If you can send bank instructions and the UBO names today, we should be able to finish setup by Wednesday.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
